This application bundles the following third-party software:

ggoled (ggoled.exe)
Source: https://github.com/JerwuQu/ggoled
License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (see ggoled-LICENSE.txt in this folder)

ggoled is not developed or maintained by the author of SteelSeries Resource
Monitor. It is included unmodified so this app can talk to the Arctis Nova
Pro base station's OLED screen over USB. Corresponding source code for the
exact version distributed here is available from the project's GitHub
releases page: https://github.com/JerwuQu/ggoled/releases

SteelSeries Resource Monitor itself remains licensed under the MIT License
(see LICENSE.txt); only ggoled.exe, a separate executable invoked as an
external process, is covered by the GPLv3 terms above.
